title: Developing EUV Lithography for High-Volume Manufacturing—A Personal Journey

passages.note: Opening, 2019 IEDM papers, and We Are All In. TSMC’s former EUV programme lead recalls using the Albany Alpha Demo Tool, evaluating NXE:3100, and moving to the 0.33 NA NXE:3300, which had first light at TSMC in October 2013. He documents foundry and scanner-maker joint development, the hurdle of reliable source output, and the announced 2019 enhanced N7 volume ramp.

lineage: Technical participant account. Yen led TSMC EUV development and was employed at ASML when he published this account. The IEDM sentences quoted by Yen are reviewed here in his account.
